description: Stage 4 pre-iteration carried-finding resolver crashes with 'Resolver commit failed: nothing to commit, working tree clean' and commits/pushes empty 'chore(review): record review ledger rows' commits when a carried finding produces no code changes.
goal: In apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/carried_findings.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/loop.py, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ledger_commit.py: (1) when a pre-iteration carried-finding resolver pass finishes cleanly with no code diff ('nothing to commit'), do not crash with 'Resolver commit failed'; if the sole carried finding is FIND-CI-* and current head CI is green or clears after target sync, clear the stale finding and continue to review/gate, otherwise halt once with blocked_on so resumes do not loop; (2) do not commit or push 'chore(review): record review ledger rows' on a pre-iteration crash when zero reviews ran and zero code changed. Add proof tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_carried_finding_clean_tree.py. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Crashing on clean working trees and pushing empty ledger commits triggers dozens of wasted CI runs across resume attempts without advancing review.
acceptance_criteria: When pre-iteration carried-finding resolution produces no code diff ('nothing to commit'), Stage 4 clears stale FIND-CI-* if CI is green or halts once with blocked_on instead of crashing with 'Resolver commit failed'.
Zero 'chore(review): record review ledger rows' commits or pushes occur when a pre-iteration carried-finding pass fails before any review runs and no code changed.
Unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/review/test_carried_finding_clean_tree.py pass via 'uv run pytest', 'uv run task lint' passes, and self-explaining code invariant holds.
